text:
### 5. Unauthorized Account Access (Account Takeover)  
**Example:** Customer discovers account used without permission  
**Investigation:**
- Immediate account freeze
- Transaction review
- Authentication review (password change?)
- Fraud team escalation
- Law enforcement notification (if warranted)  
**Resolution:**
- Full reimbursement of fraudulent transactions
- Account security reset
- Replacement card/online access reset
- Credit monitoring (if identity theft)
- Regular follow-up  
---

raw_entities.name: Account Takeover and Unauthorized Access Policy
raw_entities.description: Governs the bank's mandatory procedures for detecting, investigating, and resolving cases of unauthorized account access or account takeover. Establishes a structured workflow encompassing immediate investigative controls, resolution mandates, and escalation protocols to protect customer assets and maintain operational security standards.

raw_entities.name: Unauthorized Account Access / Account Takeover
raw_entities.description: Defines account takeover as a critical financial crime scenario where a customer's account is accessed or utilized without authorization. The policy characterizes this risk as requiring immediate intervention to prevent further loss and mandates specific remedial actions upon discovery.
context: Customer discovers account used without permission

raw_entities.name: Immediate Account Freeze Protocol
raw_entities.description: Mandates the immediate freezing of a customer's account upon discovery of unauthorized access. This control is designed to halt ongoing fraudulent activity, preserve transactional evidence, and prevent further unauthorized entries during the investigation phase.

raw_entities.name: Transaction Review Process
raw_entities.description: Requires a comprehensive review of account transactions to identify unauthorized or suspicious activity. Serves as a core investigative control that must be executed during the investigation phase to map the scope of fraudulent access and quantify losses.

raw_entities.name: Authentication and Security Reset Procedure
raw_entities.description: Requires verification of authentication methods, including password changes, followed by a complete account security and online access reset. This control ensures that legitimate customer access is restored while permanently revoking unauthorized credentials.

raw_entities.name: Law Enforcement Notification Procedure
raw_entities.description: Mandates notification to law enforcement authorities when the severity or nature of an account takeover case warrants external involvement. Ensures regulatory and legal compliance while supporting broader fraud investigations during the resolution phase.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Detection and Escalation Trigger
raw_entities.description: Establishes the trigger condition for fraud response protocols, requiring staff to escalate detected unauthorized access cases to the dedicated fraud team. Ensures timely internal investigation and coordinated resolution of account takeover incidents.
context: Customer discovers account used without permission

raw_entities.name: Fraudulent Transaction Reimbursement Obligation
raw_entities.description: Mandates the full financial reimbursement of all fraudulent transactions resulting from unauthorized account access. This resolution control ensures customer protection, mitigates financial loss, and fulfills the bank's liability obligations post-investigation.

raw_entities.name: Fraud Team
raw_entities.description: Designated internal staff collective responsible for receiving escalated account takeover cases, conducting formal investigations, and coordinating resolution steps. Holds accountability for executing transaction reviews, security resets, and law enforcement liaisons as warranted.

raw_entities.name: Fraudulent Transaction
raw_entities.description: Refers to any financial transaction executed without the account holder's permission, triggering investigation protocols and qualifying for full reimbursement. Serves as the primary financial event subject to monitoring, review, and remedial controls under this policy.
